title: Hex Feature / Terrain
note: Rolled for an UNKEYED hex on reconnoiter (reference/hexploration.md) — what the party finds when the map has no authored site here. Resource/Landmark results feed the Kingdom subsystem; lair/sign results may pair with the zone's encounter table.

entries.value: Dense forest grove — difficult terrain; timber resource; fey-quiet
River or stream ford — a crossing point; boating route; ambush spot
Rocky tor / outcrop — a landmark; stone/ore resource; a vantage
Marsh or bog — greater-difficult terrain; disease risk; hidden things
Open plains / meadow — easy travel; farmland site; exposed
Rolling hills — pasture; a cave or den in the slopes
Abandoned homestead / failed settlement — salvage; a clue to who came before
Old battlefield, cairn, or barrow — bones, history, possibly haunted
Hot spring / clear pool — rest site; healing waters; a guardian?
Cave mouth / sinkhole — a lair entrance; shelter; the dark below
Game trail to a predator's lair — tracks (Survival); a beast nearby
Fey ring / uncanny site — a First-World touch; a bargain or a prank waits
Ruined structure (tower, shrine, wall) — restorable; a secret to find
Fresh bandit / raider sign — a camp is near (pairs with an encounter)
Resource worksite — timber stand, ore vein, quarry, or fishery (claim for the kingdom)
Fertile bottomland — prime farmland site for a future settlement
Hunters' / trappers' camp — an NPC who knows the land (roll npc_role)
Marked predator territory — a dangerous beast claims these hexes
Lake, pond, or wide water — boating; an island; something beneath
Strange landmark (standing stone, lone tree, statue) — a rumor's source; a Secret site nearby
